services.name: Classes
services.desc: are typically 8 week sessions with an instructor in 1 specific medium. You can register for the full session, or take 1 class at a time as a "drop in". There are also groups that meet informally without an instructor that are free. Classes, drop in, and groups are for ages 16+. Children have their own classes and camps. services.name: Drop In's
services.desc: allow you to take a class within a session. You can sign up for as many, or as few as you want to. For more information on each class, click on view course to see dates, times, prices, and supply

services.name: Private Lessons/Party
services.desc: We know that some people are looking for more help beyond the classroom, and may need one on one instruction. Request some extra help and we can get you there. This also extends to wanting to learn a skill not offered in the classroom. Let us know what you are looking for, yourself, a group, or a party and we are happy to see how we can help. Each lesson or request will be priced separately and based off of individual need. A two hour minimum is required. Any request with minors (private lesson or party) will require parental or guardian attendance (children may not be dropped off or left unattended).
